item.title: backlog list --track filter to show only core or feature items
item.intent: Running backlog list --track core shows only core-track items, and --track feature shows only feature-track items. Without a track filter, users cannot isolate core work from feature work in one command.
steps: In .aishore/lib/cmd-backlog-read.sh, add val:filter_track:--track to the parse_opts call in cmd_backlog_list
Validate filter_track after parsing: if set, must be core or feature; call log_error and return 1 on invalid value
When filter_track is set, append a jq filter segment: select((.track // "feature") == "$filter_track") to the existing jq_filter pipeline
In .aishore/lib/cmd-help.sh, add --track <t> entry under backlog list options in _help_backlog(), aligned with existing filter flags
